items.bewering: Iemand by die huis het jou dalk elke oggend aan jou skooltas herinner toe jy klein was. In graad 6 kan jy al baie van daardie dinge self onthou.
items.bron: Harvard Center on the Developing Child, 'What is Executive Function?' (developingchild.harvard.edu): executive function skills, including working memory and planning, develop on an extended timetable from early childhood into adolescence. 'Dalk' hedges the first sentence. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Selfbestuur is om jou eie tyd en take self te beplan en te doen.
items.bron: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, 'self-management': 'taking responsibility for your behaviour, health and happiness, or for the organization of your work activities'. Cambridge: 'the ability to control and organize something such as your own work, health, or behaviour'. The lesson uses the time-and-tasks sense, which is the sense of the CAPS topic (DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Term 2: responsibilities, prioritising, activity plan). It is narrower than the full meaning, which also covers managing your behaviour and feelings, but it is not false. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Dit beteken nie dat niemand jou meer help nie. Dit beteken dat iemand jou nie elke keer hoef te herinner nie.
items.bron: Harvard Center on the Developing Child, Activities Guide 'Enhancing and Practicing Executive Function Skills with Children from Infancy to Adolescence': these skills develop with adult support rather than in its absence. That matches the claim that self-management does not mean nobody helps you any more. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Selfbestuur is ook 'n vaardigheid wat beter word hoe meer jy dit oefen.
items.bron: Harvard Center on the Developing Child: executive function skills 'develop through practice and are strengthened by the experiences through which they are applied and honed'. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: 'n Verantwoordelikheid is iets wat jou taak of plig is om te doen of na te kyk.
items.bron: Afrikaanse Wikipedia, 'Verantwoordelikheid': the obligation on a person to carry out a task assigned to them, or to see that it is done. Supertaal/gesellig.co.za dictionary entries tie it to 'plig' and 'taak'. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: By die skool reken jou onderwyser daarop dat jou huiswerk klaar is. Jy sorg self dat jou boeke en jou skoolklere die aand vooraf reg is. Jy is ook betyds by die skool en betyds in die klas.
items.bron: DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6 (education.gov.za), Gr 6 Term 2, p. 24: 'Responsibilities at school and home'. These are ordinary examples of school responsibilities, and none of them is in dispute. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Dalk het jy 'n klaspligtaak, soos om die bord skoon te vee of die plante water te gee. Die klas werk beter as elkeen sy eie deel doen.
items.bron: Johnson and Johnson's cooperative learning (Cooperative Learning Institute, co-operation.org; ERIC ED437841 'What Makes Cooperative Learning Work'): individual accountability, meaning each member does their own share, is one of the five essential elements of effective group work. The class-duty examples are hedged with 'dalk'. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: By die huis is daar ook take wat by jou ouderdom pas. Jy kan jou bed opmaak en jou eie klere wegpak. Jy kan die tafel dek, skottelgoed afdroog of die vullis uitneem.
items.bron: American Academy of Pediatrics, HealthyChildren.org, 'Age-Appropriate Chores for Children': making beds and setting the table from 5-7 years, putting away own laundry from 8-10, and harder chores from 11-12. Scholastic Parents, 'Can-Do Kids' Chores', for 8-10 year olds: make their beds, fold clean clothes and put them away, set the table, dry non-breakable dishes, empty the trash cans. Every chore named is within the ability of a Grade 6 learner (11-12 years). Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Jy sorg ook self vir jou eie goed soos jou skoene en jou skooltas. Elke huis deel sy take op sy eie manier op.
items.bron: PMC12176379 ('Understanding households in which very young children are contributing to the family') and Nature Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (2025, household chores in Ghana): how children's chores are divided varies with family culture, values and parenting style. Caring for your own things is a self-care chore on the AAP/Scholastic lists. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Dan moet jy besluit wat eerste kom. Dit noem ons prioritisering.
items.bron: Cambridge and Collins dictionaries, 'priority': 'something that is very important and must be dealt with before other things'. To prioritise is to decide what gets dealt with first. DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 6 Term 2: 'Prioritising responsibilities'. 'Eerste' here refers to order within one's own plan. It is not a historical superlative. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Thabo kyk eers wat vir môre klaar moet wees. Die wiskunde moet môre in en is dus sy eerste prioriteit.
items.bron: Eisenhower (urgent-important) matrix, as described by Asana, The Decision Lab and Todoist: work that is urgent and important, such as a pressing deadline, is done first. Homework due tomorrow fits that reasoning. It is also internally consistent: the plan list puts the maths ahead of every other task and after only a snack and rest, which the lesson presents as rest rather than a task. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Sy maats speel wel nou al, maar die wiskunde is vir hom belangriker as om dadelik te gaan speel. Daarom kom die sokker eers ná die wiskunde in sy plan.
items.bron: Consistent with the lesson's own plan list, where soccer immediately follows the maths, and with the urgent-important prioritising described by Asana and The Decision Lab. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Die projek kan wag, maar hy werk vandag tog 'n stukkie daaraan. So hoef hy nie Donderdagaand alles in een slag te doen nie.
items.bron: Eisenhower matrix (Asana, The Decision Lab): important work that is not yet urgent should be scheduled rather than left to the last moment. Timeline checked internally: it is Tuesday, the project is due on Friday, so Thursday evening is the last evening before the deadline. The plan list also includes 'werk 'n stukkie aan die projek vir Vrydag'. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: So 'n plan noem ons 'n aktiwiteitsplan. Sy plan het drie soorte dinge in: huiswerk, take in die huis en speeltyd.
items.bron: DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6 (education.gov.za, English edition p. 24), Gr 6 Term 2, Development of the self: 'Developing an activity plan: homework, house chores and playing time'. The plan list contains all three: the maths and the project, drying the dishes, and soccer. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Speel en rus is deel van die plan en nie iets wat oorbly as alles klaar is nie.
items.bron: UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, Article 31: the child's right to rest, leisure and play. UN CRC General Comment No. 17 (2013) names 'overly structured and programmed schedules' and 'pressure for educational achievement' as threats to it. CAPS itself puts 'playing time' in the activity plan. The plan list gives rest and soccer their own lines. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Jy kan ook 'n plan vir 'n hele week maak met sport en projekte daarin.
items.bron: This is a statement of possibility and is consistent with how CAPS frames the activity plan. Harvard Center on the Developing Child (Activities Guide, adolescence chapter) supports longer-range planning and organising at this age. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Ná skool: eet iets en rus 'n bietjie. / Dan: maak die wiskundehuiswerk vir môre klaar. / Dan: speel sokker saam met sy maats. / Ná ete: droog die skottelgoed af. / Dan: werk 'n stukkie aan die projek vir Vrydag. / Laaste: pak sy skooltas vir môre.
items.bron: Internal consistency checked against the prose. The maths comes before soccer, as 'Wat kom eerste?' says. The dishes come after supper ('vaste tyd net na ete'). Work on the project is today ('vandag tog 'n stukkie'). Packing the bag is last and fits 'die aand vooraf reg' in 'Verantwoordelikhede by die skool'. 'Laaste' is a position in this list and nothing else. No contradictions. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Dalk begin dit reën of kom iemand onverwags kuier. Dan skuif jy dinge rond en begin weer by die volgende taak. Thabo se sokker kan na môre skuif, maar die wiskunde moet steeds klaar wees.
items.bron: Harvard Center on the Developing Child, 'What is Executive Function?': cognitive flexibility is 'the capacity to switch gears and adjust to changing demands, priorities'. Among the skills listed is to 'revise plans as necessary'. Keeping the maths and moving the soccer is consistent with the lesson's own prioritising. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Kyk aan die einde van die dag of die week wat gewerk het. Verander dan in jou volgende plan wat nie gewerk het nie. 'n Plan help jou, maar dit loop nie altyd presies soos jy dit geskryf het nie.
items.bron: Harvard Center on the Developing Child: executive function includes the ability to 'monitor errors ... revise plans as necessary'. Johnson and Johnson list group processing, meaning reviewing what worked, as an essential element of cooperative learning. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: selfbestuur: Om jou eie tyd en take self te beplan en te doen.
items.bron: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary ('the organization of your work activities') and Cambridge ('the ability to control and organize ... your own work'). Read on its own, the entry gives the time-and-tasks sense. That sense is true but narrower than the full word, which also covers managing your own behaviour and health. It matches the study text word for word. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: verantwoordelikheid: Iets wat jou taak of plig is om te doen of na te kyk.
items.bron: Afrikaanse Wikipedia 'Verantwoordelikheid' and the Supertaal dictionary (gesellig.co.za): an obligation to carry out an assigned task or to see that it is done. It matches the study text word for word. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: prioriteit: 'n Taak wat eerste kom omdat dit belangrik is of omdat dit nie kan wag nie.
items.bron: Cambridge Essential/Learner's and Collins, 'priority': 'something that is very important and that must be dealt with before other things'. 'Kan nie wag nie' corresponds to 'must be dealt with before other things'. Read on its own, the entry is accurate. 'Eerste' is order within one's own tasks, not a factual superlative. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: aktiwiteitsplan: 'n Plan wat huiswerk, take in die huis en speeltyd elkeen 'n plek gee.
items.bron: DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6 (education.gov.za, English edition p. 24), Gr 6 Term 2: 'Developing an activity plan: homework, house chores and playing time'. The entry gives the term exactly as the curriculum frames it. Fresh check this round.

opsomming: The whole lesson was checked again from scratch. Every claim holds: the curriculum wording, the chores that suit the age, what practice does for self-management, the child's right to play and rest, and the internal logic of Thabo's plan (maths before soccer, a Friday project with Thursday evening as the last evening). There are no analogies, and the only superlatives ('eerste', 'laaste') are positions in a personal plan. One thing for a person to know, with no action needed: the definition of 'selfbestuur' gives only the time-and-tasks sense, which is true but narrower than the full word, and that matters only if another lesson in this subject uses the word for managing feelings or behaviour.
